candidats.description: Avtovo (Russian: А́втово) is a station on the Kirovsko-Vyborgskaya Line of the Saint Petersburg Metro. It was designed by architect Ye.A. Levinson and opened as part of the first Metro line on November 15, 1955. Avtovo's unique and highly ornate design features columns faced with ornamental glass manufactured at the Lomonosov factory. Although glass was originally supposed to be used on all of the columns in the station, white marble was substituted on some due to time constraints. candidats.description: This photograph captures a distinctive two-story building with a tropical architectural style, likely located in Thailand given the setting. The structure features white walls accented with light blue trim and balustrades, giving it a cheerful, coastal appearance. The building has a prominent covered porch supported by white columns, with a staircase on the right side leading up to the entrance. The upper level showcases an interesting architectural detail with a triangular, pointed roof element and a decorative balcony with blue and white balustrades.
